metas.name: Coherence
metas.description:
Captures an inversion problem in film form: eight people at a dinner party during a comet find other houses holding the same eight people, and try to tell the worlds apart with numbered photos, dice and glow sticks — markers that keep getting copied or lost.

Strange things begin to happen when a group of friends gather for a dinner party on an evening when a comet is passing overhead.

metas.name: Enemy
metas.description:
Captures two men who are observably identical. A Toronto history professor finds an actor who is his exact double — same face, scar and voice — and no measurement he can run separates them, so the film lets the ambiguity stay open.

A mild-mannered college professor investigates the life of an actor who looks exactly like him.

metas.name: Memories of Murder
metas.description:
Captures investigators failing, for real. South Korea's first serial murder case, 1986: local cops who beat confessions out of people, a Seoul detective who trusts evidence, and a country equipped for neither to work.

In a small Korean province in 1986, two detectives struggle with the case of multiple young women being found raped and murdered by an unknown culprit.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description:
Captures fame eating a person's grip on which self is hers. A pop idol turned actress, a stalker, and a fan site narrating her life in first person — the animated form is what makes the slippage work.

A pop singer gives up her career to become an actress, but she slowly goes insane when she starts being stalked by an obsessed fan and what seems to be a ghost of her past.

metas.name: Cure
metas.description:
Captures emptiness spreading from person to person. A Tokyo detective investigates murders where each killer is different, calm, and cannot explain themselves — hypnotic and grey rather than jumpy.

A frustrated detective deals with the case of several gruesome murders committed by people who have no recollection of what they've done.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description:
Captures religious paranoia eating a family from inside its own beliefs. Puritan settlers exiled to a forest's edge: a crop fails, a baby vanishes, and their theology gives them only one interpretation.

An isolated Puritan family in 1630s New England comes unraveled by the forces of witchcraft and possession.

metas.name: Lake Mungo
metas.description:
Captures grief in the form of a family documentary. Found footage, but the subject is not the ghost — it is parents and a brother in interviews, months after a drowning, still looking for anything.

Strange things start happening after a girl is found drowned in a lake.

metas.name: Hereditary
metas.description:
Captures a family where grief and resentment were already there before anything supernatural. A grandmother dies, a mother builds miniature scenes of her life, and a dinner-table argument is the scariest sequence.

A grieving family is haunted by tragic and disturbing occurrences.

metas.name: Le Samouraï
metas.description:
Captures cool as ritual and solitude. A Paris hitman in a trench coat, a grey room, a bird in a cage, an alibi arranged like furniture — almost no psychology given, all behaviour.

After professional hitman Jef Costello is seen by witnesses, his efforts to provide himself an alibi drive him further into a corner.

metas.name: The Conversation
metas.description:
Captures a man whose job is listening realising he has finally heard something. A surveillance expert replays one taped conversation until a line changes meaning, and his own privacy obsession turns on him.

A paranoid, secretive surveillance expert has a crisis of conscience when he suspects that the couple he is spying on will be murdered.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description:
Captures obsession with a case that will not close. San Francisco, years of codes, files, basements and false certainties; the killer fades and the men who chased him are what's left damaged.

Between 1968 and 1983, a San Francisco cartoonist becomes an amateur detective obsessed with tracking down the Zodiac Killer, an unidentified individual who terrorizes Northern California with a killing spree.

metas.name: Sicario
metas.description:
Captures an idealist being used as a legal fig leaf. An FBI agent attached to a border operation she is not briefed on, a convoy into Juárez filmed like an occupying army, rules revealed only after she has broken them.

An FBI agent joins a covert DoD task force targeting a Mexican cartel. Operating outside legal boundaries with a CIA handler and a mysterious fixer, she discovers the mission's true purpose goes far beyond what she was told.

metas.name: Burning
metas.description:
Captures class envy curdling into a mystery with no floor. In Seoul, a delivery kid, a girl who mimes eating a tangerine so well you see it, a rich man who burns abandoned greenhouses — and a disappearance the film will not solve.

Jong-su bumps into a girl who used to live in the same neighborhood, who asks him to look after her cat while she's on a trip to Africa. When back, she introduces Ben, a mysterious guy she met there, who confesses his secret hobby.

metas.name: First Reformed
metas.description:
Captures despair finding a political shape inside a small church. A minister keeping a diary in a historic church that is mostly a gift shop, and a young activist asking whether God can forgive us for what we've done to the world.

A minister of a small congregation in upstate New York grapples with mounting despair brought on by tragedy, worldly concerns and a tormented past.

metas.name: Solaris
metas.description:
Captures grief arriving in physical form, in orbit. A psychologist on a space station finds the crew haunted by visitors the planet below has made from their memories — including his dead wife, who knows she isn't her.

A psychologist is sent to a station orbiting a distant planet in order to discover what has caused the crew to go insane.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description:
Captures two children learning their mother's life was a war they knew nothing about. Montreal twins, a will, two sealed letters, and a journey into a fictionalised Lebanon their mother never described — it hits like a Greek tragedy.

Twins journey to the Middle East to discover their family history and fulfill their mother's last wishes.

metas.name: The Lives of Others
metas.description:
Captures a surveillance officer changed by the lives he's assigned to transcribe. East Berlin, 1984: a Stasi captain bugs a playwright's flat, types his reports, and quietly begins to edit what the state gets to know.

In 1984 East Berlin, an agent of the secret police conducting surveillance on a writer and his lover finds himself becoming increasingly absorbed by their lives.

metas.name: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
metas.description:
Captures espionage as tired old men in bad rooms. A mole inside British intelligence, investigated through retirement-age sadness, Christmas parties and files — almost nothing explodes; the atmosphere is the action.

In the bleak days of the Cold War, espionage veteran George Smiley is forced from semi-retirement to uncover a Soviet Agent within MI6.

metas.name: The Third Man
metas.description:
Captures friendship curdling in a ruined, divided city. Postwar Vienna: a pulp writer arrives to find his friend dead and getting saintlier the less sense the story makes — zither music, sewers, and the ferris wheel speech.

Pulp novelist Holly Martins travels to shadowy, mystifying post-war Vienna only to find himself investigating the mysterious sudden death of old friend Harry Lime.

metas.name: Inside Man
metas.description:
Captures a bank robbery as theatre with a purpose you have to wait for. Manhattan hostages dressed identically to the robbers, a detective and a fixer circling each other, and a heist whose real target isn't the money.

A police detective, a bank robber and a high-power broker enter high-stakes negotiations after the criminal's brilliant heist spirals into a hostage situation.

metas.name: Atlantics
metas.description:
Captures young men who leave by sea returning in another form. Dakar construction workers, unpaid for months, take a boat toward Spain; the film stays with the women left behind, the sea at night, and a love story conducted through possession and fever.

In a popular suburb of Dakar, workers on the construction site of a futuristic tower, without pay for months, decide to leave the country by the ocean for a better future. Among them is Souleiman, the lover of Ada, promised to ano...

metas.name: The Vanishing
metas.description:
Captures the need to know as a trap. Not a whodunit but a how-and-why: a man's obsession with his girlfriend's disappearance, and the ordinary, methodical man who offers him the answer at a price.

Rex and Saskia, a young couple in love, are on vacation. They stop at a busy service station and Saskia is abducted. After three years and no sign of Saskia, Rex begins receiving letters from the abductor.

metas.name: Audition
metas.description:
Captures loneliness curdling into horror by changing genre mid-film. A widower holds fake auditions to find a wife; the first hour is a sad, gentle drama before the film reveals what it actually was.

A widower has his film producer friend organize a fake audition as a means of helping him find a new girlfriend, but the woman he selects is not who she appears to be.

metas.name: Caché
metas.description:
Captures guilt that refuses to identify itself. A Paris family receives surveillance tapes of their own house with no demands attached; Haneke never says who sent them, because the film is about what the husband already knows.

A married couple is terrorized by a series of surveillance videotapes left on their front porch.

metas.name: The Father
metas.description:
Captures dementia by making the film itself unreliable. Anthony Hopkins in a flat that keeps changing its layout, furniture and occupants — you're not watching his confusion, you're inside it.

A man refuses all assistance from his daughter as he ages. When he tries to understand what is happening around him, he begins to doubt his loved ones, his own mind and even the fabric of his reality.

metas.name: Decision to Leave
metas.description:
Captures desire conducted through surveillance. A detective falls for the widow of the man whose death he's investigating, watching her through binoculars and translation apps. Park Chan-wook's most restrained and most romantic film.

A detective investigating a man's death in the mountains meets the dead man's mysterious wife in the course of his dogged sleuthing.

metas.name: Anatomy of a Fall
metas.description:
Captures a marriage being reverse-engineered in a courtroom. A husband falls from a chalet roof; his wife's trial becomes an autopsy of their relationship, conducted through recordings, translations and a dog who may be the only witness.

A woman is suspected of murder after her husband's death; their half-blind son faces a moral dilemma as the main witness.

metas.name: Tickled
metas.description:
Captures an investigation whose subject fights back in real time: journalist David Farrier asks a cheerful question about 'competitive endurance tickling' videos and receives legal threats so disproportionate that following them becomes the film.

Journalist David Farrier stumbles upon a mysterious tickling competition online. As he delves deeper he comes up against fierce resistance, but that doesn't stop him getting to the bottom of a story stranger than fiction.

metas.name: The Wicker Man
metas.description:
Captures paganism not as horror but as joy. A devout Christian policeman arrives on a Scottish island where the harvest failed and the old religion quietly resumed — and the islanders keep bursting into song, which is what makes the ending land.

A puritan police sergeant arrives in a Scottish island village in search of a missing girl, who the pagan locals claim never existed.

metas.name: The Ballad of Narayama
metas.description:
Captures a folk custom at full earthiness. Imamura's mountain village carries its old people up the peak to die at seventy, filmed with his usual gusto for sex, cruelty and teeming nature — ritual without a trace of reverence.

In a poor 19th century rural Japanese village, everyone who reaches the age of 70 has to climb a nearby mountain to die. An elderly woman is reaching close to her cut-off age during her last days with her family.

metas.name: Gabbeh
metas.description:
Captures storytelling embedded in a folk object. A nomad tribe's woven carpet unfolds as it is washed in a river: the girl in the pattern tells her own story of forbidden love, in colours as saturated as Parajanov's Carpathians.

When an old couple washes their gabbeh - a type of Persian rug - a young woman magically appears and tells them her life story.

metas.name: Kaili Blues
metas.description:
Captures a town where past, present and dream share one road. A country doctor rides to find his nephew; halfway in, the film becomes a single 41-minute take through a village where time has stopped behaving — and nobody comments on it.

While travelling the countryside to locate his nephew, a small town doctor finds himself interacting with people from his past and future.

metas.name: About Elly
metas.description:
Captures a lie told kindly, compounding. Friends invite a shy teacher on a seaside trip to set her up with a divorced friend; she vanishes on the second day, and every small politeness from the first day returns as evidence. The engine he later perfected in A Separation (#17), running rawer here.

The mysterious disappearance of a kindergarten teacher during a picnic in the north of Iran is followed by a series of misadventures for her fellow travelers.

metas.name: Long Day's Journey into Night
metas.description:
Captures a noir that dissolves into the dream it was always having. A man returns to Kaili hunting a woman from twenty years ago; the final hour is one unbroken take inside a dream, in 3D in cinemas — the rare film where you can feel it cross over.

A man went back to Guizhou, found the tracks of a mysterious woman. He recalls the summer he spent with her twenty years ago.

metas.name: Out 1
metas.description:
Captures Paris as a conspiracy that may just be theatre people. Nearly thirteen hours: two experimental theatre troupes rehearsing Aeschylus, a drifter intercepting mysterious letters, and a secret society that might be a game everyone agreed to forget. The longest film in this batch by design — it changes your sense of what a film's runtime is for.

Following the May 1968 civil unrest in France, a deaf-mute and a con artist simultaneously stumble upon the remnants of a secret society.

metas.name: Timecrimes
metas.description:
Captures a time loop as a man becoming his own haunting. A guy with binoculars, a bandaged stranger, a scientist with a tank — three trips through one hour, each pass reassigning who the villain is. The tightest loop mechanics ever filmed, on a Spanish hillside with almost no budget.

A man accidentally gets into a time machine and travels back in time nearly an hour. Finding himself will be the first of a series of disasters of unforeseeable consequences.

metas.name: The Man from Earth
metas.description:
Captures an entire science-fiction epic conducted as a conversation. A professor tells his colleagues he's a 14,000-year-old caveman who stopped ageing; nobody leaves the room, no effect is ever shown, and the argument itself becomes the spectacle.

A professor's impromptu retirement party becomes a mysterious interrogation when he reveals to his colleagues that he has a longer and stranger past than they can imagine.

metas.name: The Double
metas.description:
Captures a man replaced by the version of himself with better settings. A clerk nobody notices meets his double, who is identical and effortlessly everything he isn't; Dostoevsky rebuilt as a clanking bureaucratic nightmare with Jesse Eisenberg against himself.

The unenviable life of a government-agency clerk takes a horrific turn with the arrival of a new co-worker who is both his exact physical double and his opposite otherwise--he's a confident, charismatic ladies' man.

metas.name: Ghost in the Shell 2: Innocence
metas.description:
Captures a detective and his mostly-robotic partner investigating murdered dolls that begged to die. Denser and stranger than the first: every character quotes philosophy at each other while the camera orbits ball-jointed gynoids in a festival parade that took a year to animate. The observed/observable problem, with dolls as the transducers.

In the year 2032, Batô, a cyborg detective for the anti-terrorist unit Public Security Section 9, investigates the case of a female robot--one created solely for sexual pleasure--who slaughtered her owner.
